title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copy Sales and Purchase Line Descriptions (Type G/L Account) to G/L Entries
summary: Business Central can copy G/L Account line descriptions from sales and purchase documents to their resulting general ledger entries when posting. Enable the 'Copy Line Description to G/L Entry' checkbox in Sales & Receivables Setup or Purchases & Payables Setup to include line descriptions in G/L entries for auditing and reconciliation purposes.
key_points: G/L Account line descriptions from sales and purchase documents are not copied to G/L entries by default
Enable the 'Copy Line Description to G/L Entry' setting in Sales & Receivables Setup or Purchases & Payables Setup
This feature helps with reconciling and auditing expenses by showing source document descriptions in general ledger
The same functionality is available for service documents via Service Management Setup
features: Copy Line Description to G/L Entry

quotes.text: When we post G/L Account in Sales Document or Purchase Document, line descriptions will not be copied to G/L Entries.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the default behavior that users need to understand before enabling the feature

quotes.text: When reconciling or auditing data, such as expenses, it is useful to see the source document line description in the general ledger entries.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the business value and use case for this functionality
